assignments.reason: Nesi'ut panim (the lifting/shining of the divine face) is the positive state of the kavod — when divine honor has its 'face' restored. The Torah states 'על־ידי־זה הוא נשיאות פנים' as the direct expression of kavod being intact. Its essential nature is the face of divine honor, squarely in the kavod/malkhut domain.

assignments.node_id: אין שום פקידות ושררה להעזי פנים
assignments.reason: This node describes a condition of the brazen-faced (azei panim) — specifically, their loss of authority and appointment. Its essential nature is a state of the brazen-faced ones themselves. Even though the state is their defeat, the concept belongs in the evil-domain package because it is about them and their dominion (or lack thereof). It is the mirror-image within the evil cluster.

assignments.node_id: שלחן, דהינו על־ידי אכילה בקדשה כנ"ל
assignments.reason: This is the table of holy eating — a variant expression of the already-assigned שלחן שבקדשה. The Torah states the table is the bechina of keter malkhut (Yoma 72b) and kavod. Its essential nature is the holy table as the seat of divine kingship.

He'arat panim (illumination of the face) is the shining of God's countenance — the positive expression of kavod restored. The Torah states 'בחינת הארת פנים על־ידי השלחן' — the face-illumination comes through the table, which is the crown of kingship. Its essential nature is the luminous face of divine honor.

Holadah (birthing) is the act of bringing the new soul into the world. The Torah states 'שתי בחינות אלו, דהינו ההולדה והגדול' — birthing and growth are the two phases of the soul's emergence. Its essential nature is the birth process itself, which is a structural threshold — neither pure good nor evil, but the neutral creative act of spiritual emergence.

Giving honor to an elder who forgot his learning is an act of kavod-giving. The Torah frames it as the mechanism that produces thunder (re'amim) and restores wisdom, but the act itself IS giving kavod. Its essential nature is an act of honoring — the practical expression of the kavod domain applied to the forgotten elder.

The revelation of the elder's wisdom is the restoration of kavod to its proper place — the wise. The Torah states that the departure of wisdom from the elders was caused by the departure of kavod (through prayerless heart), and its return is the kavod returning to the meveinei mada. The essential nature is the restoration of divine honor's intellectual face.

The 'aspect of the hands' refers to the two hands (yad ha-gedolah and yad ha-hazakah) as instruments of divine sovereignty. The verse context is 'ואתה מושל בכל... ובידך כח וגבורה ובידך לגדל ולחזק' — the hands belong to the divine King. The essential nature is the instrumental power of divine kingship, not the birth process itself.

The passing/resolution of birth-difficulty is the completion of the birth process — when the kishui (hardship) is overcome and the soul emerges. Its essential nature is the resolution of the birth-pain, belonging squarely in the birth/growth domain as the outcome of the birthing threshold.

Raising the kavod and malkhut from the sitra achra is the redemptive act within the kavod domain — elevating divine honor from its fallen state among the brazen-faced. Its essential nature is the restoration/elevation of kavod, the central theme of Package 1.

Growing/raising the soul is the second phase of the soul's emergence — after birth comes growth. The Torah states 'ואחר שנולד, אזי מגדילין אותה על־ידי האהבה'. Its essential nature is the growth process of the newly-born soul, belonging in the birth/growth-of-soul domain.

Same essential nature as 'בחינת ידים הנ"ל' — the two hands of divine sovereignty referenced in the verse 'ואתה מושל בכל... ובידך כח וגבורה ובידך לגדל ולחזק לכל'. The hands are the instruments through which the divine King exercises power over the kavod-clothed soul. Package 1 (divine kingship).

Birthing and growing the soul 'clothed in the kavod' — the defining frame is that this process occurs within the kavod. The node explicitly states 'המלבשת בהכבוד' (clothed in the kavod). Its essential nature is the kavod as the womb/mother of the soul, which is Package 1's central teaching: kavod is the mother of all living and the root of all souls.

Thunder is explicitly the voice of kavod — 'אל הכבוד הרעים ה׳ על מים רבים' (Psalm 29:3). The related node 'קול הרעמים' is already in Package 1. Thunder is the mechanism by which kavod (fire) enters the clouds (forgetting) and breaks them open, producing the waters of wisdom. Its essential nature is the acoustic expression of divine honor.

Cold water that revives the weary soul. The Torah states these waters are the waters of knowledge (דעה) that flow from the thunder of kavod. They heal the soul's separation from kavod. The verse proof is 'מים קרים על נפש עיפה' (Proverbs 25:25). Its essential nature is the healing/reviving waters that emanate from the kavod-thunder system — the nourishing output of divine honor.

assignments.node_id: מתקן הפגם שגרם על־ידי שהתפלל בלי כונת הלב
assignments.reason: Repairing the damage of heartless prayer is the tikkun (repair) of the kavod-nefesh connection. The Torah states this damage caused 'הסתלקות החכמה מן הזקנים' and 'התרחקות הנפש מן הכבוד'. The repair restores the nefesh to the kavod. Its essential nature is the restoration of the kavod-soul bond.

Breaking the food craving is the correct relationship to the שלחן (table), which is the כתר מלכות (crown of kingship). The Torah states 'כי שלחנו של אדם היא בחינת כתר מלכות... וכשפוגם באכילה אזי נפגם הכבוד'. The food craving's breaking IS the sanctification of the table, which IS the kavod. Its essential nature is the holy discipline of the table — the foundational act that preserves divine honor.

Transforming tzedek into tzedakah (adding the ה of five chasadim to the fallen צדק) is the essential redemptive act of the charity domain. The Torah states 'ועל־ידי בחינת החמשה חסדים על־ידי־זה מוסיפין ה, ונעשית מצדק צדקה'. Its essential nature is the transformative power of tzedakah/chesed — the addition of grace to bare justice.

assignments.node_id: מה שנותנין כבוד לזקן ששכח תלמודו
assignments.reason: Variant wording of 'נותנין כבוד לזקן ששכח תלמודו' — the act of giving honor to the forgotten elder. Same essential nature: an act of kavod-giving that produces thunder (re'amim). Belongs in the kavod/malkhut domain as the practical expression of honoring.
